decisions.decision: Personnel Committee members signed off on 2 Personnel Action Forms.

decisions.decision: Elaine Peterson will prepare the COLA article and send it to Lin Vickery for her signature; an administrative order is being presented at the Annual Town Meeting.
decisions.quote: elaine peterson, will prepare the article and send to lin for her signature.

decisions.decision: The Personnel Committee will review the Town of Shirley compensation and classification study the committee has a copy of.
decisions.quote: the town of shirley did a compensation and classification study and we have a copy of that study, which will be reviewed.

decisions.decision: The Personnel Committee will schedule a special meeting on Saturday, April 2 from 9:30 to 12:30 at the Town Hall to review job descriptions.
decisions.quote: in order to review the job descriptions the personnel committee will schedule a special meeting on saturday, april 2

decisions.decision: The Personnel Committee will discuss the draft Employee handbook at the May committee meeting; BOS approval is needed for the handbook and any training.
decisions.quote: there is a draft employee handbook and the personnel committee will discuss this at the may committee meeting.

decisions.decision: Review of Talent Bank forms and Performance Evaluation Templates is postponed until after the SAP salary schedule steps, job descriptions, handbook review and training are done.
decisions.quote: personnel committee decided to postpone this topic until after we accomplish the sap salary schedule steps, job descriptions, review of the handbook and training.

decisions.decision: Discussion of the DPW Director grade in comparison with the market analysis is moved to the April 2 meeting.
decisions.quote: discuss dpw director grade in comparison with market analysis.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Employees covered by the SAP, about 20-22 town employees, requested a 2% cost of living adjustment for each of three consecutive fiscal years, with no increase in 5 years.
budget_items.quote: were looking for a cost of living adjustment of 2% for next three consecutive years (fiscal years 2017 through 2019)

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Kerry LaFleur said there was money set aside in her budget for the increase, and that yearly increases typically vary based on contracts.
budget_items.quote: kerry stated that there was money set aside in her budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The committee will discuss the DPW Director pay grade against a market analysis at its April 2 meeting; no dollar figures printed.
budget_items.quote: discuss dpw director grade in comparison with market analysis.
